name: 459e45c3f2f5
claim: PORTAL_BIND_LAN=0 binds the Mac portal to localhost:8002 only; PORTAL_BIND_LAN=1 is required so LAN peers can reach /api/peer-inbox on the discovered Mac address; the portal is bound to 0.0.0.0:8002 when set to 1.

decisions.notes: Mac portal health on HTTPS 8443 passed from the Windows probe once PORTAL_BIND_LAN=1; portal binds 0.0.0.0:8002 for LAN reachability.

rationale: MAC_IP must equal the discovered Mac address; PORTAL_BIND_LAN=1 is required for LAN peers to reach /api/peer-inbox.
